items.title: Akiyoshi Toshiko — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he told me, said, “You know, Hampton Hawes is coming. We are trying to get him into our camp.”

ctx.x: …called Raise Up Off Me. And page 62, he‟s talking about, he was talking to a woman, a Japanese woman, and she says, “I‟ll take you to the Harlem Club, where‟s there‟s a girl, Toshiko, plays like Bud Powell.” So, um, the Harlem Club, could you talk about that? Do you remember the Harlem Club?
Well, what I remember is that there was a bass player called Nabil Totah.
